finish_summary: 1) bulk_discount_percent: implementation returns 5% for quantity 50, but spec requires 10%. 2) parse_coupon: whitespace after code causes ValueError; implementation does not strip whitespace. 3) remove_item logic leaves item with quantity 0 in cart; spec says remove when quantity reaches 0 or less. 4) total shipping fee calculation uses original subtotal instead of discounted amount, causing shipping to be computed incorrectly as seen in test_cart_total_shipping_bug.
